provenance.note: Chronics of l2rpn_case14_sandbox are synthetic time series; every state is a Grid2Op/backend AC power-flow result (modeled), not a measurement.

agent.name: do_nothing
agent.description: Grid2Op DoNothingAgent: never takes an action.

reasons: BackendError: Grid2OpException BackendError "Divergence of DC powerflow (non connected grid) at the initialization of AC powerflow. Detailed error: ErrorType.SolverFactor"

kpi_definitions.survival_steps: env steps played before game over (game over at step k => k-1); equals max_steps if the bounded episode completed
kpi_definitions.survived: true iff no game over within max_steps
kpi_definitions.overload_line_steps: sum over played steps of the number of connected lines with rho > 1
kpi_definitions.steps_with_overload: number of played steps with at least one connected line at rho > 1
kpi_definitions.disconnection_events: connected->disconnected line transitions between consecutive valid states (protection trips, forced outages, maintenance or agent actions)
kpi_definitions.actions_count: agent steps whose applied action is legal and not do-nothing (illegal and scenario-forced actions excluded)
kpi_definitions.illegal_actions: agent actions Grid2Op declared illegal (replaced by do-nothing by the env)
kpi_definitions.blocked_actions: agent actions replaced by do-nothing because they tried to reconnect a line inside a scenario outage window
kpi_definitions.forced_events: steps whose action was imposed by the scenario (forced line outage)
kpi_definitions.cumulative_reward: sum of the environment reward over played steps, including the game-over step (reward class recorded in env.reward_class)
kpi_definitions.mean_rho: mean rho over connected lines and valid played states
kpi_definitions.max_rho: max rho over connected lines and valid played states
kpi_definitions.max_topological_distance: max over states of #disconnected lines + #substations with any element on bus 2

game_over_reasons: BackendError: Grid2OpException BackendError "Divergence of DC powerflow (non connected grid) at the initialization of AC powerflow. Detailed error: ErrorType.SolverFactor"
